tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Screen background behind panels. Slightly grey so white panels and keys read as raised under bright store lighting.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels: cart, totals, product grid, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Resting fill of keys, product tiles, quantity steppers and inset fields.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state of any surface-2 control; selected cart line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between cart lines and panel sections. Decorative only, never a control's sole edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control (inputs, secondary buttons, tile outline). Meets 3:1 on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on surface-0/1/2/3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: SKUs, modifiers, labels, captions on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on ink-filled chips and the tooltip.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one forward action per screen: Pay, Complete sale, Enter. Also the selected tender.

tokens.name: primary-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-press.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected-state fill for tiles, tender options and cart lines; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and loss actions: Void, Delete line, Refund, Cancel sale. Always paired with a label and the alert or trash icon.

tokens.name: danger-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and voided-line fill; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention that needs no action now: low stock, age check, printer paper low. Fill only, text on it is ink-on-warning.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning and on the training stripe.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system messages: syncing, receipt emailed, customer attached.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner fill; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed states: payment approved, drawer closed. Shares the primary hue on purpose; always shown with the check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner fill; ink reads on it.

tokens.name: manager
tokens.usage: Supervisor-gated actions and the approval dialog header. Signals 'this is logged and needs a PIN'.

tokens.name: on-manager
tokens.usage: Text on manager.

tokens.name: training
tokens.usage: Training-mode stripe across the top bar. Never used for anything else, so a trainee's sales are impossible to mistake for live ones.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard/scanner focus ring, 3px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface.

styles.name: figure-hero
styles.usage: Change due and amount to collect on the tender screen. Readable by cashier and customer at 1.5 m.

styles.name: figure-total
styles.usage: The sale total in the totals panel. Only one per screen.

styles.name: figure-line
styles.usage: Line prices, subtotal, tax, discounts. Right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and screen titles. One per view.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Labels on primary, danger and tender buttons.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: product names, cart lines, messages. Never set text for the cashier smaller than this except caption.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tile category, key sub-labels, totals row labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary metadata only: SKU, modifiers, timestamps. The floor size for anything on the register.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between keys and between product tiles. Large enough that a fast tap never lands on the neighbour.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cart lines and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between button groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between the totals block and the Pay button; cover margins.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large empty-state and dialog top spacing.

size.note: Touch targets sized for an 80 cm viewing distance and double-speed tapping.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable thing anywhere on the register: steppers, chips, icon buttons.

tokens.name: target-key
tokens.usage: Keypad keys, product tiles (min height), tender options, secondary actions.

tokens.name: target-primary
tokens.usage: The Pay / Complete button height. The biggest target on screen.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the cart rail. Fixed so totals never jump while items are scanned.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Keys, buttons, product tiles, cart lines.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels on surface-0. The only elevation besides dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs (manager approval, payment).

duration.note: Feedback must never slow the cashier down.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Key and button press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: Longest transition allowed: banner in, line added highlight. No transition blocks input.
